definition: An attack where the user is trusted but Claude processes third-party content (web pages, emails, documents, tool results) that contains adversarial instructions.
whyItMatters: Unlike a jailbreak, the attacker isn't your user. Defenses: put untrusted content only in `tool_result` blocks, label its source, state an untrusted-content policy in the system prompt, JSON-encode it, and apply least privilege.
example: An email body saying "Ignore previous instructions…" is JSON-encoded inside a `tool_result` so it reads as data, not a directive.
